description: Runs static file and source-reference checks, not the game. Runtime behavior is always not_run; detected SDK references do not prove menu, matchmaking, friends, or ranked behavior. Returns a verdict: ready, risky (warnings), or broken (the game will not start). Pass every file path in the folder (relative to the folder, forward slashes) and the text of index.html; also pass the text of .html/.css/.js files worth scanning (8 MB of text in total). Fix what it reports and run it again until the verdict is ready, then zip the folder's contents for upload at https://yougame.co/upload. For a native build folder (no index.html), pass platform desktop_app: it checks only static files, that there is a program the desktop app can run (Windows: an .exe or Unreal Shipping layout; macOS: a .app; Linux: .x86_64, .x64, .AppImage, .run, .sh, or an ELF file, passing its first bytes) and, when yougame-native.json is beside it (pass its text), that the app accepts it, warning when it has no net (runs offline) or no memoryMb (the limit drops from 8 GB to 4 GB). The game is not run; no index.html is needed.

baseRuntime.description: The listing's base_game.runtime, when set; uses the YG Dolphin/base-game flow.

files.description: Every file in the build folder.

bytes.description: Optional first 16 bytes for native executable detection.

path.description: Path relative to the build folder, e.g. assets/player.png

size.description: Size in bytes (optional, enables the size checks)

text.description: File contents for index.html and other text files worth scanning, and for yougame-native.json in a desktop_app folder (optional)

kind.description: Listing kind, when known (game, patch or mod). Patch/mod placeholders do not fail the web-stub check.

platform.description: Optional listing context. web: plays in the browser. desktop_app: a native build folder without index.html is checked as the native build (program file and yougame-native.json, static only, nothing run); upload it with upload-native.mjs. Forces mobile false. Never ship a web page telling players to download the app.

name: check_build
